author: xeophon
review_level: immutable source bytes and static AST/caller inspection only
facts: Before returning its EvaluationBatch, evaluate computes scores with _episode_score after _run_batch has completed.
The landed guard rejects an entire episode if any trace is_dropped, including a reward-less dropped seat or one retaining prior rewards.
Unchanged scoring averages trace.reward over traces with a truthy rewards map; no such traces yields 0.0. Finite recorded zero remains in that mean.
Trace.is_dropped checks dropped is not None, and drop does not clear rewards. Trace/episode definitions are identical across this parent and landing.
make_reflective_dataset has no separate dropped guard. Normal evaluate refuses to return trajectories for such a batch, but this does not validate externally constructed batches.
_run_batch passes on_complete into env.run_slot before scoring. The guard is after rollout; it provides no rollback of model cost or earlier persistence callbacks.
The merge changes one production file and adds no test. Full upstream imports, runner teardown/retry/recovery and downstream prime-rl admission were not executed or fully reviewed.
our_inference: Pin this GEPA admission boundary separately from trace storage and trainer filtering. A mixed-seat drop is a failed optimization batch, not a selectively reduced scoring denominator; attempted rollout costs and persisted artifacts still need accounting.
limitations: Static inspection only; no upstream tests, package imports, service, model or training execution.
Direct adapter caller inspected; external GEPA optimize exception handling and env.run_slot persistence/recovery closure are not established.
The absence of tests refers to this exact one-file merge, not the entire upstream test suite.
